source: Products neurodivergent people and families recommend; each checked on its maker's or seller's own pages (.qa-local/products/BRIEF.md): every quality has a quote from those pages, in quality_evidence

entries.name: Maple Leaf Prime® Breaded Dino Chicken Nuggets
entries.description: Breaded chicken nuggets shaped like dinosaurs, sold frozen in 700 g bags. A familiar, fun-shaped finger food for children who like their chicken plain and predictable.
entries.price_note: Prices vary by store (Walmart.ca listed the 700 g bag at $11.97 on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: Maple Leaf Prime® Breaded Dino Chicken Nuggets 700 g
entries.notes: Contains wheat and soy (per the maker's ingredient list). The chicken is "Prime Raised without Antibiotics" per the maker. Walmart.ca also sells a cheaper Great Value dino nugget; the Walmart link is a search page because its product pages block automated checks.

entries.name: Weetabix Original
entries.description: A whole-grain wheat breakfast cereal with a three-part ingredient list: whole grain wheat, sugars (barley malt extract and cane sugar) and salt. A plain cereal for people who want few ingredients.

quality_evidence.short_ingredients: Whole grain wheat, Sugars (barley malt extract, cane sugar), Salt

entries.price_note: Prices vary by store (Walmart.ca and Amazon.ca listed the 400 g box at $4.47 on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: Weetabix Nutrition Facts Panel Ingredients Whole grain wheat, Sugars (barley malt extract, cane sugar), Salt Contains: Wheat, Barley
entries.notes: The team's "Wheat-a-Bix". Sold in Canada by Post Consumer Brands Canada; its brand link opens the Brands page, where Weetabix Original's ingredients are listed. Contains wheat and barley (not gluten-free).

entries.name: Honey Maid Graham Wafers
entries.description: Honey graham crackers, sold in Canada as Graham Wafers in 400 g boxes. Eaten plain, with a topping, or used for s'mores and pie crusts.
entries.price_note: Prices vary by store (Amazon.ca and Walmart.ca listed the 400 g box at $6.28 on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: Enjoy Honey Maid Graham Wafers plain or topped with your favourite toppings.
entries.notes: The team named Honey Maid honey graham crackers; this is the Canadian box. Contains wheat and soy, and lists artificial flavour (Amazon.ca ingredient list). The maker's Canadian site has only a brand page, so details come from the Amazon.ca listing.

entries.name: Pop-Tarts® Frosted Strawberry
entries.description: Toaster pastries with a soft crust, a strawberry-flavoured filling and icing with sprinkles, eaten toasted or straight from the box. Sold in boxes of 8 and family boxes of 16.

quality_evidence.texture_soft: Soft golden crust stuffed with a strawberry-flavoured filling

entries.price_note: Prices vary by store (on 19 October 2026 Walmart.ca listed the 8-pastry 384 g box at $3.47 and Amazon.ca the 16-pastry 768 g box at $5.94)
entries.evidence: Soft golden crust stuffed with a strawberry-flavoured filling, frosted with yummy icing and topped with coloured sprinkles; Sweet, fully baked, and ready to eat
entries.notes: Kellogg's Canadian site refused the fetch tool (HTTP 405), so details come from the Amazon.ca listing, used as the main seller page. Contains wheat and soy; the sprinkles are coloured. Walmart.ca also lists a Frosted Strawberry Milkshake flavour, which is a different product.

entries.name: Nutella®
entries.description: A smooth, sweet hazelnut and cocoa spread for bread or toast, made in Brantford, Ontario. The same recipe in every jar size, which matters to people who notice small changes.

quality_evidence.texture_smooth: contributes to the smoothness of our cream
quality_evidence.short_ingredients: Each jar of Nutella® contains 7 carefully selected, high-quality ingredients
quality_evidence.consistent: Same unique recipe, different jar sizes.

entries.price_note: Prices vary by store and jar size (Walmart.ca listed the 375 g jar at $4.37, on sale from $5.47, on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: Each jar of Nutella® contains 7 carefully selected, high-quality ingredients: sugar, milk, palm oil, cocoa, hazelnuts, lecithin and vanillin.
entries.notes: Contains hazelnuts (a tree nut), milk and soy, so it is not for nut-free schools. Sold in 375 g, 725 g and 1 kg jars; Nutella & GO! snack packs are a separate product.

entries.name: Goldfish® Flavour Blasted® Xtreme Cheddar
entries.description: Fish-shaped cheddar crackers with a cheese seasoning: a stronger-tasting version of Goldfish Cheddar. Sold in 180 g bags and packs of 26 g snack bags.

quality_evidence.single_serve: Goldfish® Flavour Blasted® Xtreme Cheddar Crackers Snack Packs 6 x 26g

entries.price_note: Prices vary by store and size (Walmart.ca listed the 180 g bag and the 6 x 26 g snack packs at $2.24 each on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: When snack time calls for ultimate cheesiness, Goldfish® Flavour Blasted® Xtreme Cheddar is the answer.
entries.notes: The shop already has Goldfish Cheddar; the team asked for Flavour Blasted as a separate product (stronger flavour, different seasoning). Contains wheat and milk; the cheese is coloured with annatto. A 750 g carton is also sold.

entries.name: Simply CHEETOS® Puffs White Cheddar
entries.description: Puffed cornmeal snacks with a white cheddar seasoning, from Cheetos' "Simply" line. Its ingredient list names no colours.
entries.price_note: Prices vary by store (Walmart.ca listed the bag at $4.26 on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: Simply CHEETOS® Puffs White Cheddar Cheese Flavoured Snacks Our SIMPLY Snacks are made with ingredients you can feel good about
entries.notes: The team asked for the natural/simply kind of Cheetos Puffs if sold in Canada: this is it. Contains milk. Not tagged "no artificial colours" because the maker's page does not say so in words (its ingredient list has no colours). Walmart.ca also lists "Cheetos Simply NKD Puffs", but no maker page for it could be found (guessed URLs gave empty placeholder pages).

entries.name: Farm Boy™ Colossal Soft Pretzel (Cinnamon Sugar or Salted)
entries.description: Large frozen soft pretzels that you heat and serve, from the Ontario grocer Farm Boy's own brand. Made in Canada, in Salted or Sugar Cinnamon.
entries.price_note: Farm Boy's page shows no price; sold in Farm Boy stores
entries.evidence: Savour the taste of our jumbo-sized soft pretzels, made the old-fashioned way with quality ingredients and a classic recipe.
entries.notes: BORDERLINE: a store brand sold only in Farm Boy's Ontario stores; no national frozen soft pretzel could be confirmed on a page our tools can read (SuperPretzel and Auntie Anne's showed no Canadian seller; PC Express and Voila pages do not load for the tool). 300 g pack, 150 g per pretzel. The kept page is the Cinnamon Sugar one; it says a Salted version is sold too. Contains wheat, milk and barley.

entries.name: Giuseppe Pizzeria Easy Pizzi - 3 Cheese Mini Pizza
entries.description: Small rectangular frozen snack pizzas with tomato sauce and three cheeses (mozzarella, cheddar and Monterey Jack), sold in 560 g boxes. A plain cheese option for a quick lunch or snack.
entries.price_note: Prices vary by store (Walmart.ca listed the 560 g box at $6.27 on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: Dr. Oetker Giuseppe Pizzeria Easy Pizzi 3 Cheese is a rectangle shape snack pizza that's easy to eat!
entries.notes: Also sold as Pepperoni and Pepperoni & Bacon. The maker's page lists no allergens, so check the box (wheat and milk are expected). Dr. Oetker's Ristorante Piccolissima is another mini pizza it sells in Canada.

entries.name: Natrel Vanilla Ice Cream Mochi
entries.description: Small frozen treats: vanilla bean ice cream wrapped in a slightly sweet rice dough, eaten with your fingers. Sold in boxes of six, from a Canadian dairy brand.
entries.price_note: Prices vary by store (Walmart.ca listed the box of 6 x 35 ml at $5.48 on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: Taste the new vanilla mochi made with vanilla bean ice cream, wrapped in a slightly sweet rice dough.
entries.notes: Contains milk and wheat; may contain peanuts, tree nuts and soy (maker's page). Also triple chocolate, mango and raspberry. Natrel is owned by Agropur, a Canadian dairy co-operative. Not tagged soft or chewy because the maker's page does not use those words; Lotte and Buono ice cream mochi are also sold at Walmart.ca.

entries.name: Pizza Pops Three Cheese
entries.description: Frozen pizza snacks: a golden crust filled with mozzarella, white cheddar and tomato sauce. The three-cheese kind has no meat, for people who want a plain filling.
entries.price_note: Prices vary by store and box size (Walmart.ca listed the 30-count 2.85 kg box at $20.37 on 19 October 2026)
entries.evidence: Loaded with cheesy, lovely goodness. Golden Pillsbury Pizza Pops Crust loaded with awesome stuff!
entries.notes: The team's "pizza rolls / pizza pops". Sold in 380 g, 760 g, 2.85 kg and 3.42 kg sizes per the maker; Pepperoni is the other common flavour. Contains wheat and milk; the topping lists titanium dioxide (colour).

entries.name: Girls Full Body Swimsuit Stinger Suit Long Sleeves & Legs UV Protection UPF50+
entries.description: A one-piece swimsuit with long sleeves and long legs, made of a light, stretchy UPF 50+ fabric with flat seams. For children who want full sun cover, or the even feel of one suit over the whole body.

quality_evidence.soft_fabric: The soft fabric of this swimsuit is breathable
quality_evidence.breathable: fabric is light weight and breathable keeping your skin cool even in hot weather conditions
quality_evidence.seamless: Anti-Chafe due to its Flatlock stitching design
quality_evidence.sold_in_canada: We ship to virtually any address in the world, including our most active destination countries: USA, Canada

entries.price_note: Price on ecostinger.com on 19 October 2026. The page shows $54.90 without a currency code; the store is US-based (US phone line), so it is taken as USD. Free shipping over $59.
entries.evidence: Girls Junior Full Body Swimsuit Stinger Suit Long Sleeves UV Protection UPF50+ Navy Blue; The fabric of this stylish swimwear is durable and extremely flexible
entries.notes: PRICE IN USD (see price note). Girls’ sizes 4 to 16; EcoStinger also sells a boys’ full-body range. Ships from outside Canada: free shipping takes 10 to 14 days and duties may apply. A smaller brand: the Canadian options found (Jan & Jul, Calikids, Hatley) have long sleeves but short or ruffled legs, or refused the fetch tool.

entries.name: Adult Muslin Blanket (Twin, 90" x 66")
entries.description: A plain, lightweight blanket of six layers of 100% cotton muslin, sold in Throw, Twin (90 x 66 in), Queen and King sizes. Suits people who find fleece or wool blankets too warm or rough.

quality_evidence.soft_fabric: We use 100% Muslin cotton in our soft muslin blankets
quality_evidence.sold_in_canada: Free shipping on all Canada orders

entries.price_note: Price for the Twin size (229 x 168 cm) on Amazon.ca on 19 October 2026; the maker’s own site lists the blanket from $49.99 CAD (Throw size)
entries.evidence: Breathable Muslin Cotton – We use 100% Muslin cotton in our soft muslin blankets which means they’re gentler on sensitive skin and keep your body cooler throughout the night.
entries.notes: The team asked for a twin-size plain muslin blanket. The Sand colour was sold out on the maker’s site on 19 October 2026 (other colours are listed); Amazon.ca had the Twin in Neptune in stock, sold by Comfy Cubs. The maker’s site prices in CAD and ships free in Canada.

entries.name: Kids Organic Original Sweatpant
entries.description: Classic fleece sweatpants for kids aged 6 to 14, in organic cotton and recycled polyester, with a drawstring waist and elastic cuffs. For children who will only wear soft, familiar clothes.

quality_evidence.washable: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle with like colours

entries.price_note: Price on roots.com (Canada) on 19 October 2026; that day Roots also took 25% off when buying 2 or more sweats
entries.evidence: Built for school days and slow weekends, the Roots Kids Organic Original Sweatpant delivers soft fleece comfort with a classic fit kids can move in.
entries.notes: For the team’s "literally anything not scratchy". Roots is a Canadian brand, but this page does not say where the sweatpant is made, so it is not tagged Canadian-made. Not tagged tagless (the page does not say); it has a flocked logo on the front. Toddler and adult versions are sold too; Roots customers rate it 3.2 out of 5.

entries.name: AVEENO Eczema Care™ Moisturizing Cream
entries.description: A fragrance-free, steroid-free daily body cream made with oats and ceramides, sold for eczema-prone skin. A plain, non-greasy cream the maker says is gentle enough for the whole family, babies included.

quality_evidence.eczema_accepted: accepted by the Eczema Society of Canada
quality_evidence.for_children: gentle enough for the entire family, even babies’ delicate skin
quality_evidence.for_adults: gentle enough for the entire family, even babies’ delicate skin

entries.price_note: Price for 300 mL on well.ca on 19 October 2026 (the listing’s text also says 330 mL; Aveeno’s page shows a 166 mL tube)
entries.evidence: It’s gentle enough for the entire family, even babies’ delicate skin. Steroid-free, fragrance-free, paraben-free Formulated with non-GMO oats
entries.notes: Sold in Canada for eczema symptoms; the maker’s page makes clinical claims that this entry does not repeat. "Formlated" is the maker’s spelling. The Eczema Society of Canada acceptance is stated on the well.ca listing. Different from AVEENO Daily Moisturizing Lotion, already in the shop; Aveeno also sells a Baby Eczema Care cream.

entries.name: Eucerin Eczema Relief Body Creme
entries.description: A fragrance-free, dye-free body cream with colloidal oatmeal and ceramide, sold for eczema-prone skin. The maker says it suits babies over 3 months, children and adults.

quality_evidence.eczema_accepted: Seal of acceptance of the Eczema Society of Canada
quality_evidence.for_children: Suitable for use on babies (over 3 months of age), children and adults
quality_evidence.for_adults: Suitable for use on babies (over 3 months of age), children and adults

entries.price_note: Price for 226 g on well.ca on 19 October 2026
entries.evidence: Eucerin Eczema Relief Body Creme provides long-lasting hydration to help relieve minor skin irritation and itching due to eczema.
entries.notes: Eucerin’s Canadian page says babies over 3 months; the well.ca listing says over 6 months, so check the tube. The relief claims are the maker’s; this entry makes none.

entries.name: RESTORADERM® Eczema Soothing Moisturizer
entries.description: A fragrance-free body moisturizer with ceramides and 1% colloidal oatmeal, sold for dry, itchy, eczema-prone skin. It absorbs quickly, per the maker, so it suits people who dislike a heavy cream.

quality_evidence.eczema_accepted: Accepted by the Eczema Society of Canada

entries.price_note: Price for 295 ml on Amazon.ca (sold by Amazon.ca) on 19 October 2026
entries.evidence: After cleansing, follow with RESTORADERM® Eczema Soothing Moisturizer which provides soothing relief to dry, itchy, irritated skin.
entries.notes: The team named Cetaphil Eczema Calming; in Canada Cetaphil sells this RESTORADERM moisturizer for the same use (and a separate Baby Eczema Calming lotion). Active ingredient: colloidal oatmeal 1%. The maker’s relief claims are not repeated here.

entries.name: CeraVe Itch Relief Moisturizing Cream
entries.description: A fragrance-free, steroid-free moisturizing cream with ceramides and 1% pramoxine hydrochloride, an anti-itch ingredient. Sold as a medicated cream for adults and children 2 years and older.

quality_evidence.for_sensitive_skin: Suitable for all skin types, gentle on sensitive skin

entries.price_note: Price for 340 g on well.ca on 19 October 2026
entries.evidence: 1% Pramoxine Hydrochloride: Provides temporary relief associated with minor skin irritations, insect bites, sunburn and scrapes
entries.notes: A medicated cream: follow the label (no more than 3 to 4 times a day; ask a doctor if symptoms last more than 7 days). The maker’s page says "CeraVe does not treat underlying skin conditions." Different from CeraVe Moisturizing Cream, already in the shop; a lotion version is also sold.
